'''Lorana''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] owner of [[Lorana's Labyrinth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]]. She had a soft spot for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and would happily provide [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] with information on Kelada and the [[Anarid Cluster]]. She would also happily help smugglers escape [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents, and helped [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] on a number of occasions.<ref name="Smugglers Log">{{JournalCite|1|Smuggler's Log}}</ref>
